content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the age limit.

rows.information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai
Online, through the "Apply Now" link on the TISS website

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088. Its letterhead describes it as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. This post supports research activities under a project, and the notice is signed by the Project Leader.

content_sections.heading: TISS Senior Research Associate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The post is unreserved, but candidates from reserved categories may also apply. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.pay: Rs 65,000/- per month (consolidated), subject to qualifications and experience

content_sections.heading: TISS Senior Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree in Social Sciences, Humanities, Development Studies, Education, Management or another relevant discipline, from a recognised university. At least 2 years of relevant experience in research or academic project coordination. Experience in higher education or research institutions is preferred. Preference goes to candidates with a PhD or advanced doctoral-level research experience, especially in disciplines relevant to the academic programmes. Strong research, analytical and academic writing skills Excellent written and spoken English Ability to prepare research proposals, project reports, presentations and institutional documents Strong project coordination, planning and organisational skills Proficiency in MS Office, data management tools and digital collaboration platforms Ability to coordinate with faculty, researchers, international partners and administrative teams Ability to handle several tasks at once, meet deadlines, and work both independently and in a team In exceptional cases, the Institute may relax the qualification, experience or age limit. It may also do so for a person who already holds an analogous position in a Government Department, a Research and Academic Institution, or Industry. For full eligibility details, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Support the coordination and implementation of international research projects, programmes and collaborative academic initiatives Coordinate with international partner institutions, researchers and stakeholders on project planning, implementation, meetings and academic activities Help track project timelines, milestones, deliverables, budgets and documentation Keep systematic records, databases and documentation of international research collaborations, academic programmes and project outcomes for institutional reporting and review Help develop and maintain institutional systems, processes and databases for managing international collaborations Support compliance with institutional policies, partnership agreements, regulatory requirements and reporting procedures Carry out research, data collection and analysis for planning, monitoring and evaluating international research projects and academic programmes

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online. An application is valid only once the fee, where applicable, has been received. Fees are not refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: SC / ST / PWD (with required certificate attached)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications may be shortlisted. Having the prescribed qualification and experience does not by itself guarantee an interview call. Shortlisted candidates will be told by e-mail to attend a Personal Interaction (interview) at TISS, Mumbai. Documents are verified at the time of the Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Senior Research Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents to bring to the Personal Interview: Self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates and ID proof The original documents, for verification A No Objection Certificate from your employer, if you are currently employed

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Associate posts are there at TISS?
faq.answer: There is 01 position. It is unreserved, but reserved-category candidates can also apply.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated Rs 65,000/- per month, subject to qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is a PhD compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The mandatory qualification is a Master's degree in Social Sciences, Humanities, Development Studies, Education, Management or another relevant discipline. A PhD or advanced doctoral-level research experience is only preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience do I need?
faq.answer: You need at least 2 years of relevant experience in research or academic project coordination. Experience in higher education or research institutions is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. Do women candidates pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No, women applicants do not pay a fee. SC/ST/PWD candidates pay Rs. 125/- if they attach the required certificate.

faq.question: Q6. Which e-mail ID should I use in the form?
faq.answer: The notice requires a Gmail ID in the online application form. Interview calls are sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The Personal Interaction will be held at TISS, Mumbai. The Institute's address is V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the appointment, and how soon must I join?
faq.answer: It is a temporary 1-year contract, and the selected candidate must join within 15 days of selection.
